title: Rez call that works in Group Finder groups
quote: In a pick-up key I am not always the party leader, and my rez call has to reach strangers in the chat they actually read.
what: The rez call can be sent by anyone in a 5-player group, not only the leader, and goes to instance chat when the group came from the Group Finder. An option whispers the chosen rezzer as well, since strangers miss party lines.
possible: Partly on Retail and WoW: Forever (chat sending can be blocked in combat and during keys, so it queues); Possible on the other clients
today: Today: leader-only in a party (CanRequestRez), and it sends to PARTY or RAID, with no instance-chat or whisper path

title: Mark guessed cooldowns on players without the addon
quote: I need to know whether that Shaman really has lust up or whether the addon is just assuming it because it never saw a cast.
what: Players who do not run the addon get a small question mark on their rows, meaning 'ready as far as we know, never confirmed'. Confirmed rows (addon users, or your own readable spells) look normal.
possible: Partly on Retail and WoW: Forever (those hide casts, so strangers stay guessed); Not needed on Era, TBC and MoP, which read the combat log
today: Today: the roster is built from class and level, so strangers show as ready placeholders with nothing telling them apart from confirmed users

title: Pull countdown readout
quote: When the pull timer starts I want one glance that says lust is up, battle rez has a charge, and who has externals, before I commit.
what: When a pull countdown starts (the built-in or a boss-mod timer), the Essentials bar flashes a one-line status: lust ready or not, battle rez charges, externals ready count. It fades after the pull.
possible: Partly on Retail and WoW: Forever (only your own lust and the charge pool are readable, others are assumed or shared by addon users); Possible on Era, TBC and MoP
today: Today: no countdown or pull event is used anywhere in the code; the bar only shows current state

title: Clear the board when a key starts
quote: Cooldowns reset when the key starts, and I do not want last dungeon's timers telling me lust is on cooldown.
what: On key start (and on entering a new dungeon or leaving a finished one) the tracked cooldowns clear back to ready, and players who left are dropped. One setting turns it off.
possible: Partly on Retail and WoW: Forever (key start is a Retail event); Possible on the other clients for dungeon entry resets
today: Today: the code has no challenge mode or zone-change handling, and timers only come from observed casts and the 5 s duplicate rule

title: Group comp check when the group forms
quote: I want to know the moment the fifth player joins that we have no lust or no battle rez, so I can ask before the key starts.
what: When the group fills (or on a button press), it prints or shows one line: who brings lust, who brings battle rez, and a plain warning if either is missing. It counts classes only, so it works with strangers.
possible: Possible on every client (class and level based, lust is absent on Era and Forever so it only checks what exists)
today: Today: /cdc roster lists providers on demand, but nothing warns about a missing one or fires on group changes

title: Dead list with one-click rez call
quote: Someone dies mid-pull and I do not have time to click their corpse, then the rez button, then check who is alive.
what: When a groupmate dies, their name appears in a small strip with a button. One click picks the best living provider with a ready battle rez and calls it, no targeting needed. If no charge is left, the strip says so instead.
possible: Partly on Retail and WoW: Forever (battle rez charge pool is readable, but other providers' readiness may be guessed); Possible on the other clients
today: Today: Request Rez needs the dead player targeted first, via the Rez button or /cdc rez

title: Externals ready tally
quote: Before a tank buster pull I only need to know how many externals and group defensives I still have, not read a whole list.
what: A single small tile shows 'Defensives ready: 3' counting the tracked external and raid defensive spells that are ready, with a tooltip of who and what. It sits on the Essentials bar so the screen stays tiny.
possible: Partly on Retail and WoW: Forever (only addon users and your own spells count, so the number is a floor); Possible on Era, TBC and MoP
today: Today: Essentials shows lust, battle rez and flask or food only, and defensives live only in the main list
